description: A large knob that sends an influence voltage to the Luci cells patched to it, setting how far a neighbour's pulse moves their phase

params.text: Sets how much a neighbour's pulse moves a cell's phase, 0 for a full reset at the minimum and almost no movement at the maximum

inputs.text: Nothing in the module reads this jack; the code adds a parameter rather than the jack's voltage to the output

outputs.text: Carries the influence setting for the cells patched to it

notes: the panel prints min and max at the bottom corners of the knob's travel, and a Luci cell reads 0V as a full phase reset
